## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in this workstation profile.

## Safety and rollback

Describe system mutations, `-WhatIf` behavior, backups, and the rollback path.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Relevant runtime checks pass on a supported Windows system
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated
- [ ] No private logs, machine inventories, credentials, or local paths are included
- [ ] Adapted or vendored material records its source revision and license
